name: Injuukan no Kyoufu
source:
The case occurred in the old mansion located in a suburb in Sydney. A special team comes to the premises for invesitgation, no one knows that monsters born by bio-technology dwell inside. Countless zombies and tentacle monsters wriggling and waiting for the female member breaks in....
Can she escape alive from there!?

A Resident Evil hentai horror/survival game with long-length hentai animation!!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE014121.html]DLsite English[/url]]

案件发生在位于悉尼郊区的一栋老宅内。一支特别小组来到这里进行调查，但没人知道里面居住着通过生物技术诞生的怪物。无数的丧尸和触手怪物蠕动着，等待着女成员的闯入……
